name: Ivan Horvat
bio:
Ivan Horvat's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his university days, fueled by a fascination with the complex data streams generated by Formula One cars. Initially pursuing a degree in theoretical physics, Ivan quickly realized his passion lay in applying analytical skills to the real-world challenges of racing. After graduation, he started as a junior analyst for a small Croatian rally team, honing his skills in data interpretation and performance optimization.

His meticulous approach and knack for identifying subtle patterns in data led him to a role with Akkodis ASP Team. Ivan thrives on the pressure of extracting actionable insights from vast datasets, always striving to provide the team with a competitive edge. He is known for his ability to translate complex statistical models into clear, concise recommendations that engineers and drivers can easily understand and implement. Ivan's loyalty to the team and relentless pursuit of perfection make him an invaluable asset.

Ivan is driven by a desire to uncover hidden advantages, pushing the boundaries of data analysis within motorsport. His signature method involves creating bespoke algorithms tailored to specific track conditions and driver styles, giving Akkodis ASP Team a unique advantage.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ivan is of average height with a slightly wiry build and a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on listening to classical music while analyzing data, claiming it enhances his focus.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically against his desk when deep in thought.
